body: CAPRIA, the battle commander who led her people out of hell as a girl, leader of the Bannor in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; woman; about thirty-five; tall and strong. Fair skin, a thin pale scar across one cheekbone, a strong square jaw, dark chestnut hair, grey eyes, two fine lines of strain between the brows.
costume: a high-collared white linen shirt under a silver-edged white wool mantle, a red cross stitched on its breast.
signature: Her long thick CHESTNUT BRAID always hangs forward over one shoulder.
extra: She holds herself like a soldier on parade whatever she feels: back straight, chin level.

vibes.name: Hell's Survivor
vibes.line: Her right hand clutching a blanket closed at her throat, her left gripping the bed rail, knuckles white, jaw clenched, face forced still, grey eyes wide on nothing past the viewer; a stone bedchamber in the small hours, steeped crimson-black by a dying hearth, as if hell lingers there.
vibes.wears: a plain undyed linen nightshirt laced to the throat, long in the sleeve, a dark grey wool blanket snatched round her shoulders.

vibes.name: Order's Sword
vibes.line: Her right fist holding her short sword upright before her face, the blade a bright line between her eyes, her left hand laid flat over the red cross on her breast, eyes straight on the viewer, lips set; a white citadel wall at dawn, rose-gold light behind white towers.
vibes.wears: polished white enamelled plate edged in gold, a white tabard with a red cross on the breast, a short white cape.

vibes.name: Iron Commander
vibes.line: Her right hand jabbing a rolled battle map toward a flank off frame, her left gripping the pommel of her sheathed sword, mouth wide on a barked order, eyes cut to the side; a windswept ridge at white noon, an army in drilled ranks below under crimson-and-white banners.
vibes.wears: a long mail hauberk under a crimson surcoat with a white cross, a steel gorget, a grey fur-lined field cloak thrown back from one shoulder.

vibes.name: Never Afraid
vibes.line: Her right hand laid steady on the shoulder of a young soldier, a calm smile, eyes level on the troops off frame, while her left hand, hidden from them at her side, trembles in a white-knuckled fist; a camp on the eve of battle at moonrise, cold blue light.
vibes.wears: a plain soldier's greatcoat of dark blue wool buttoned to the throat, a mail collar beneath, no rank but a small silver sword badge.
